institutions.title: Tang y Zhou de Wu Zetian
institutions.text: Gaozu, Taizong yGaozong tienen reinados distintos. La regencia deWu tras683 se distingue de su propia dignidad imperial y dinastía Zhou desde690. No se mantiene Tang como dinastía reinante en los años deZhou.
institutions.note: Contexto parcial; cronología de fuente y localización no equivalen a control diario.

governance.note: Institución regia documentada. La palabra imperio no determina por sí sola ideología ni régimen moderno.

record.label: Dinastía Tang
record.note: Geometría de síntesis con cronología de fuente desigual; consulta anual no equivale a fronteras observadas anualmente ni a control uniforme.

geography.note: Componentes originales completos, con propiedades e índices conservados; sin simplificación añadida.

reignFields.office: Crown Prince of the Tang dynasty

reignFields.raw: 18 June 618{{efn|Was already in control of [[Chang'an]] and de facto ruler of western China since 12 December 617}} – 4 September 626{{efn|Abdicated in favor of his son, and was honored with the title ''[[Taishang Huang]]'', a title reserved for retired emperors. The ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Taizong assumed the throne on the ''jiazi'' day of the eighth month of the ninth year of the ''Wude'' era of Tang Gaozu's reign. This date corresponds to 4 Sep 626 on the Gregorian calendar.<ref>[(武德九年八月)甲子，太宗即皇帝位于东宫显德殿...] ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'', vol.191</ref> While Gaozu's and Taizong's biographies in ''New Book of Tang'' recorded the same coronation date as ''Tongjian'', their biographies in ''Old Book of Tang'' recorded the coronation date as the ''guihai'' day of the same month and year, i.e. the day before (3 Sep 626). ''Tongjian'' recorded that on that day, Gaozu attempted to cede the throne to Taizong; the latter declined to accept.<ref>[(武德九年八月)癸亥，制传位于太子；太子固辞，不许。] ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'', vol.191</ref>}}
572 – 20 December 617<ref>On 20 December 617, Tang was promoted to a princedom. ([大业十三年]十一月...甲子，隋帝诏加高祖假黄钺、使持节、大都督内外诸军事、大丞相，进封唐王，总录万机。以武德殿为丞相府，改教为令。以陇西公建成为唐国世子...) ''Jiu Tang Shu'', vol.01</ref>

reignFields.office: Retired Emperor of the Tang dynasty

reignFields.raw: 27 February 684<ref name=start1st>Volume 203 of the ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Ruizong was made emperor under Wu Zetian on the ''jiwei'' day of the 2nd month of the 1st year of the Guangzhai era of his reign. This date corresponds to 27 Feb 684 in the Gregorian calendar. {{bracket|{{lang|zh|(光宅元年二月)己未，立雍州牧豫王旦為皇帝。}}}} ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol. 203.</ref><ref name=ZZTJ203>''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'', [[:zh:s:資治通鑑/卷203|vol. 203]].</ref> – 16 October 690<ref name=end1st>Volume 204 of the ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that the dynastic change from Tang to Wu Zhou took place on the ''renwu'' day of the 9th month of the first year of the Tianshou era of Wu Zetian's reign. This date corresponds to 16 Oct 690 in the Gregorian calendar. {{bracket|{{lang|zh|(天授元年九月)壬午，御则天数，...，以唐为周，改元。}}}} ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol. 204.</ref><ref name=ZZTJ204>''Zizhi Tongjian'', [[:zh:s:資治通鑑/卷204|vol. 204]].</ref>
25 July 710<ref name=ZZTJ209>''Zizhi Tongjian'', [[:zh:s:資治通鑑/卷209|vol. 209]].</ref> – 8 September 712<ref name=ZZTJ210>''Zizhi Tongjian'', [[:zh:s:資治通鑑/卷210|vol. 210]].</ref>

4 September 626{{efn|The ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Taizong assumed the throne on the ''jiazi'' day of the eighth month of the ninth year of the ''Wude'' era of Tang Gaozu's reign. This date corresponds to 4 Sep 626 on the Gregorian calendar.<ref>[(武德九年八月)甲子，太宗即皇帝位于东宫显德殿...] ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'', vol.191</ref> While Gaozu's and Taizong's biographies in ''New Book of Tang'' recorded the same coronation date as ''Tongjian'', their biographies in ''Old Book of Tang'' recorded the coronation date as the ''guihai'' day of the same month and year, i.e. the day before (3 Sep 626). ''Tongjian'' recorded that on that day, Gaozu attempted to cede the throne to Taizong; the latter declined to accept.<ref>[(武德九年八月)癸亥，制传位于太子；太子固辞，不许。] ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'', vol.191</ref>}}{{snd}}10{{nbsp}}July 649

reignFields.office: Emperor of China (northern Shaanxi/western Inner Mongolia)

reignFields.raw: 3 January 684<ref>Volume 203 of the ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Zhongzong was made emperor under Wu Zetian on the ''jia'zi'' day of the 12th month of the 1st year of the ''Hong'dao'' era of Tang Gaozong's reign. This date corresponds to 3 Jan 684 in the Julian calendar. {{bracket|{{lang|zh|(弘道元年)十二月，...甲子，中宗即位，...}}}} ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol. 203.</ref> – 26 February 684<ref>Volume 203 of the ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Zhongzong was deposed by his mother [[Wu Zetian|Empress Wu]] on the ''wu'wu'' day of the 2nd month of the 1st year of the ''Guang'zhai'' era of Tang Ruizong's reign. This date corresponds to 23 Jan 684 in the Julian calendar. {{bracket|{{lang|zh|(光宅元年)二月，戊午，太后集百官于乾元殿，裴炎与中书侍郎刘祎之、羽林将军程务挺、张虔勖勒兵入宫，宣太后令，废中宗为庐陵王，扶下殿。}}}} ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol. 203; Wu then made Zhongzong's brother Ruizong her next puppet emperor.</ref>

23 February 705<ref>Restored as emperor three days after the coup that put an end to his mother's power. Volume 207 of the ''[[Zizhi Tongjian]]'' recorded that Zhongzong assumed the throne on the ''bingwu'' day of the 1st month of the 1st year of the Shenlong era of Wu Zetian's reign. This date corresponds to 23 Feb 705 in the Gregorian calendar. {{bracket|{{lang|zh|(神龙元年正月)丙午，中宗即位。}}}} ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol. 207. </ref> – 3 July 710
